sections.Profile:
The "Gold Star" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1954, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1954
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Pageantry, Women, Wood Rail, Original Theme
